title: Predicting environmental stressor levels with machine learning: a comparison between amplicon sequencing, metagenomics, and total RNA sequencing based on taxonomically assigned data
summary: Machine-learning models predicted insecticide and fine-sediment stressor levels from microbial sequencing profiles in stream mesocosms; 16S sequencing performed best among evaluated profiling approaches. Evidence is limited to the stated retrospective/in-silico/prototype setting.
